groups.confidence: confirmed discrepancy and mechanism; Perl scripts not fully rerun
groups.mechanism: Native utility receives an absolute argv[0] in the retained mixed launch. gnulib deliberately preserves path-qualified argv[0]; tests expect basename invocation. seq's first-only s/-0/0/ also edits the path component e138-01 instead of the negative-zero operand.
groups.not: not an English translation error or incorrect cut/seq/pr data algorithm

groups.confidence: confirmed; residual layer localized to runtime/API permission semantics, not an ARM64 arithmetic/codegen defect
groups.kind: configuration plus genuine MSYS/Windows POSIX semantic gaps
groups.mechanism: noacl cannot encode Unix mode/group requirements (mktemp600 becomes644; directories remain755). Enabling ACL in a fresh private root fixes group/read/temporary-file semantics, but seven shell tests still expose unlinkat child deletion despite nonwritable parent or traversal despite nonsearchable parent. Direct runtime API fixture reproduces those boundaries without Coreutils.
groups.not: not reclassified as inapplicable: the POSIX behaviors remain genuinely unsupported/failing

groups.confidence: confirmed boundary discrepancies; original parent PID/birth/callsite receipt does not exist, so exact legacy boundary implementation is not retroactively reconstructed
groups.kind: mixed launch/runtime namespace and file-descriptor interoperability
groups.mechanism: Retained parent and native child disagree on symlink/root mapping, process IDs, /proc/version byte length or inherited special-file descriptors. Logs show /cygdrive paths remapped under host-bootstrap, kill($!) reporting ESRCH while tail remains alive, wrong proc skip length and wc EBADF. Coherent native-parent replays fix these without utility changes, including selected old-baa-runtime controls.
groups.not: not proof that tail/od/wc need output normalization or that inotify must be skipped

groups.confidence: byte-level discrepancy confirmed; not a date parser/calendar calculation error
groups.mechanism: The exact invalid B0 date argument is reported as EF82B0 (UTF-8 private-use U+F0B0) in the retained stderr. Same binary under coherent native old/current parents preserves B0 and produces the expected diagnostic; deliberately passing EF82B0 recreates the observed diagnostic. The secondary invalid-TZ mismatch is argv0-only.
groups.not: not a message-catalog lookup or line-ending problem

groups.confidence: all four retained failure mechanisms identified; no claim that the entire help-version script now passes
groups.kind: several launch failures plus a missing support-file layout
groups.mechanism: Four named retained failures: csplit // converted to /; native kill cannot resolve parent's background PID; ln/readlink cannot represent the requested link; stdbuf cannot locate real libstdbuf.dll. Quoting/syslink/PID controls and installing the original real DLL in /usr/lib/coreutils remove these specific symptoms. The full fresh script remained bounded-incomplete; the new all-native harness also lacks gzip.
groups.not: not one generic help/version implementation bug

groups.confidence: two original secondary mechanisms remain unconfirmed; common diagnostic mechanism is confirmed
groups.kind: known argv0 failures plus incompletely recorded secondary launch behavior
groups.mechanism: join has seven argv0-only diagnostics plus one A7-separator status mismatch; wc has six argv0-only diagnostics plus /dev/null files0 status mismatch. Exact coherent-native subcases succeed; PUA-encoding the join separator reproduces exit1. Original offending argv/file-descriptor snapshots were not retained, so those secondary root causes remain unconfirmed rather than assigned a cosmetic pass.
groups.not: not evidence of a current join data algorithm failure or justification to waive the original failures

groups.mechanism: xargs refuses exec because the inherited environment exceeds its available exec budget, before the tail assertions. Small-environment unchanged script exits0; explicit 40000-byte environment reproduces the exact xargs diagnostic and raw failure.
groups.not: not a tail/inotify defect and not a permission/locale assumption

groups.confidence: confirmed setup limitation; test not run to its behavioral assertions
groups.kind: test-harness facility not supplied by this target ABI
groups.mechanism: The injected readdir helper cannot compile: RTLD_NEXT is undefined in the target dlfcn.h. The test requires ELF-style next-definition lookup through dlsym plus LD_PRELOAD to inject readdir errors. Failure is at helper compilation, before any rm behavior is exercised. The direct native API diagnostic confirms the header capability remains absent.
groups.not: not an rm failure and not silently changed to SKIP/PASS; needs a target-appropriate real fault-injection facility

locale_scope: Upstream lang-default and Perl scripts force C locale; official CLANGARM64 gettext is a different ABI/provider and not imported by these MSYS targets.
